text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The government raised the speed limit to 100 km per hour outside town and villages. The experiment lasts from July 15 to August 15.
- The parliament hall will be restored to its original appearance during the summer recess.
- The law on state secrets passed the first reading in the parliament.
- Art collector Shifara Hindrikson gave a portrait of Russian diplomat Prince Alexander Gorchakof by Estonian painter Johann Koler for two years to the Russian Embassy.
- The Estonian House was opened in Tallinn yesterday to serve as a connection between local and foreign Estonians.
- A new excise duty raised beer prices by 20 sents in the shops.
- A draft law on the working order of the government would increase the role of the ministry chancellors.
- Parliament granted universities a public service income tax exemption.
